decision_scope: The 48 unjudged selections establish operational viability and a cost basis only; they do not choose an arm or establish selection quality.
publication_note: Review copy with user-home paths redacted. Execute from the original local artifacts; hashes refer to unredacted raw artifacts unless explicitly labelled published-copy hashes.

remaining_336_scheduling_forecast.basis: Repeat each same-state, same-arm fresh-worker rep0 outer wall for the seven unrun repetitions. Conservative per-cell basis is max(5 seconds, 2*measured+1 second). This is an operational scheduling estimate, not paired timing or quality evidence.
